tools/lint/import-policy.mjs.reason: One oxlint plugin. Its rules share the path model (tier, project, section), the package graph and the registry loader, so a split would pass them between files.

packages/sync/runtime/pool.ts.reason: The object pool is one closure over its state. Each module of the pool loads before the first paint and counts against the first-screen budget of check-bundle, so a split costs a module there.
